title: Power Platform governance and engineering example
description: An editable example framework. This is not a certified assessment or a reproduction of a proprietary maturity model.
framework: Power Platform maturity · illustrative example framework

levels.name: Initial
levels.description: Activities are informal, inconsistent or reactive.
levels.guidance: Demonstrate the practices described at level 1 consistently across the assessed scope.
levels.evidence: Record dated examples, artefact references and the extent of adoption.

levels.name: Developing
levels.description: Some repeatable practices exist but are not consistently applied.
levels.guidance: Demonstrate the practices described at level 2 consistently across the assessed scope.
levels.evidence: Record dated examples, artefact references and the extent of adoption.

levels.name: Defined
levels.description: Standardised processes, policies and responsibilities are established.
levels.guidance: Demonstrate the practices described at level 3 consistently across the assessed scope.
levels.evidence: Record dated examples, artefact references and the extent of adoption.

levels.name: Managed
levels.description: Practices are measured, governed and continuously monitored.
levels.guidance: Demonstrate the practices described at level 4 consistently across the assessed scope.
levels.evidence: Record dated examples, artefact references and the extent of adoption.

levels.name: Optimised
levels.description: Practices are continuously improved using evidence, automation and feedback.
levels.guidance: Demonstrate the practices described at level 5 consistently across the assessed scope.
levels.evidence: Record dated examples, artefact references and the extent of adoption.

capabilities.name: Governance and environment strategy
capabilities.description: Separate workloads by purpose, sensitivity and lifecycle with clear ownership.
capabilities.evidence: Illustrative evidence: Review environment inventory, provisioning rules and exception decisions. A sample review in September found the practice in two of four teams, with inconsistent follow-up.
capabilities.recommendations: Agree a consistent approach for governance and environment strategy, assign ownership, and review adoption at the next quarterly assessment.
capabilities.risks: Inconsistent adoption could leave critical services without a clear accountable owner.
capabilities.notes: Fictional data supplied to demonstrate the tool. Replace with your own assessment.

criteria.text: Review environment inventory, provisioning rules and exception decisions.
